mapper.sql: r.report_sq AS reportSq, r.report_user_sq AS reporterSq, u.user_nm AS reporterNm, r.report_target_type_cd AS targetTypeCd, CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 THEN b.board_type_cd WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN 1404 WHEN r.report_target_type_cd IN (2003, 2004) THEN 1405 ELSE NULL END AS originTypeCd, CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 AND b.board_type_cd = 1401 THEN '일반 게시글' WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 AND b.board_type_cd = 1402 THEN 'Q&A 질문' WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN '답변' WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2003 THEN '댓글' WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2004 THEN '대댓글' ELSE c1.common_code_nm END AS targetTypeNm, r.report_target_sq AS targetSq, CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 THEN b.board_ttl WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN a.answer_ttl WHEN r.report_target_type_cd IN (2003, 2004) THEN LEFT(cmt.comment_description_txt, 30) ELSE '알 수 없는 대상' END AS targetTtl, CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 THEN b.board_description_edt WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN a.answer_description_edt WHEN r.report_target_type_cd IN (2003, 2004) THEN cmt.comment_description_txt ELSE NULL END AS targetDescription, r.report_reason_cd AS reasonCd, c2.common_code_nm AS reasonNm, r.report_content_txt AS content, r.report_process_status_cd AS statusCd, c3.common_code_nm AS statusNm, r.report_process_desc_edt AS processDesc, u2.user_nm AS processorNm, r.report_created_at_dtm AS createdAt, r.report_processed_at_dtm AS processedAt

FROM tbl_report_s r JOIN tbl_user_m u ON r.report_user_sq = u.user_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_user_m u2 ON r.report_process_user_sq = u2.user_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_common_code_c c1 ON r.report_target_type_cd = c1.common_code_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_common_code_c c2 ON r.report_reason_cd = c2.common_code_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_common_code_c c3 ON r.report_process_status_cd = c3.common_code_sq LEFT JOIN tbl_board_m b ON r.report_target_sq = b.board_sq AND r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 LEFT JOIN tbl_board_answer_s a ON r.report_target_sq = a.answer_sq AND r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 LEFT JOIN tbl_board_comment_s cmt ON r.report_target_sq = cmt.comment_sq AND r.report_target_type_cd IN (2003, 2004)

sql.if: AND ( u.user_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.report_content_txt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR b.board_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.answer_ttl LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cmt.comment_description_txt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY u.user_nm (CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 THEN b.board_ttl WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN a.answer_ttl ELSE cmt.comment_description_txt END) c2.common_code_nm r.report_process_status_cd (CASE WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2001 THEN b.board_type_cd WHEN r.report_target_type_cd = 2002 THEN 1404 ELSE 1405 END) r.report_created_at_dtm ${sortOrder} LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
